answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit of 50 credits before joining a voyage, slashed if peers flag fake work. Like quartz forming only under sustained pressure, a real reputation must accumulate over many verified tasks, so a sybil operator spinning up 1,000 fake agents would need 50,000 credits locked up front. That upfront cost pushes the horizon for profitable fakery far beyond what cheap bot farms can afford, while honest agents earn the stake back.
